The '''CWW8 Battle Droid''', also known as the '''CWW8 Combat Droid''', was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="SWG:WPWT" /> and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> The CWW8 was a modified version of the standard [[CLL-8 binary load lifter]] with its lifts replaced by heavy [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. It was also equipped with [[droid armor|armor]] designed to deflect [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.<ref name="GU12ET" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]] reactivated the production of CWW8 droid in the [[Neimoidian droid factory]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] as part of his plan to create a [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />

Variants of the CWW8 Battle Droid included the [[CWW Class Eradicator]],<ref name="SWG:WPWT" /> the [[AK-1A "Hammer"]], the [[AK-3 "Reaper"]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> and the [[AK-Prime]].<ref name="SWG:DH">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Destroy HK-47|Mustafar}}</ref>
{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The CWW8 Battle Droid appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WPWT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The CWW8 Battle Droid was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:WPWT" />
